                   Subject:  BHC’s Proposal to Conduct Job Evaluation and a Remuneration Review on CEO
                             Position at the Pacific Harbour Board of Papua New Guinea (PHB)

                   Thank you for reaching out to Concept Group and subsequent discussions regarding the
                   aforementioned subject and for the opportunity to submit a proposal.

                   Our response consists of:
                   •   This Letter as our formal Proposal to undertake the assignment;
                   •   Brian Hart Consulting’s Company Profile (Attachment 1); and
                   •   The List of 2025 Korn ferry Pay Participants (Attachment 2)

                   From our understanding the Board of PHB require a Remuneration review of the CEO’s position in
                   comparison to remuneration packages paid to comparable enterprise roles in PNG.

                   We would recommend conducting market comparison against Statutory Bodies or the Resources
                   Sector, from the 2025 KF Pay Participants List. Refer list in Attachment 2. Alternatively, you can
                   select a comparison cohort from that same list consisting of a minimum of 12 and maximum of 20
                   companies.

                   Brian Hart Consulting (BHC) are the authorised distributor for Papua New Guinea, for Korn Ferry
                   and have been the PNG Agents for Korn Ferry for over 35 years.
                   We have worked in PNG as Human Resource Consultants since the mid-1980’s. Our history,
                   working with Government Departments, Statutory Authorities, State Owned Enterprises and
                   Public Companies, including 14 Financial Services companies, on directly comparable projects,
                   places us in good stead to conduct this review which will result in a Comprehensive Report on the
                   current and proposed remuneration structures of PHB.

                   BHC has particular expertise in assisting organisations like PHB in undertaking Benchmark
                   Reviews, showing how PHB’s current Remuneration Policies compare with the PNG Market in
                   general and preparing the necessary Submissions to the Board and SCMC.
                   By way of some background, BHC have been undertaking this sort of work in PNG for over 30
                   years and have done similar work for a number of organisations including:

                   Brian Hart Consulting Limited would undertake the following Scope of Works.

                   Scope of Works

                   Brian Hart Consulting Limited will:
                       1.  Conduct a review of the CEO’s Job Description to determine the appropriate Korn Ferry
                           Reference Level;
                       2.  Using the Korn Ferry (previously Hay) Job evaluation methodology conduct Job
                           Evaluation of the CEO’s role based on PHB’s organisation size in comparison to other
                           similar PNG Institutions;
                       3.  Conduct a market comparison by reviewing, benchmarking and analysing the CEO’s
                           existing remuneration and benefits against other CEO roles in comparable Public and
                           Private Sector organisations;
                       4.  Review the make up of the CEO’s package and advise on current practice in the PNG
                           Market;
                       5.  Develop and recommend a salary benefits structure based on an appropriate salary
                           baseline; and
                       6.  Prepare a Remuneration Submission for the Board’s and SCMC consideration.

                   We will require an updated Job Description of the CEO’s position and details on current
                   remuneration package. To conduct the evaluation, we would require the PHB’s Organisation
                   Structure, PHB Act or Corporate Plan and current salary structure grade table, if one exists.

                   We will then undertake a market review to confirm where the CEO’s position sits in comparison to
                   the PNG market, based on the Job Evaluation result.

                   From there we will:

                       1.  Prepare a summary showing where the CEO’s position sits against the comparison
                           market with respect to Base Salary, Fixed Annual Reward and Total Annual Reward.
                       2.  Indicate where there are internal and external equity issues of the position against the
                           PNG Market.
                       3.  Provide related data and recommendations for an appropriate Pay and Remuneration
                           setting for consideration.
                       4.  Prepare a Submission to the Board recommending a competitive remuneration package.
